comment: Template exclusion lists for different test types. 'exclude_list' contains permanent exclusions that apply to all tests. 'main_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from spoiler-minimal and multiclient tests. 'worldgen_test_exclude_list' contains games excluded from world-generator tests. 'ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list' contains community apworlds excluded from UT fuzz testing due to incompatible rule patterns or apworld bugs. 'requires_javascript_helpers_list' contains games that require JavaScript helpers (excluded from new-rule-types prompts). 'exporter_fully_simplified_list' contains games whose exporters are fully simplified (excluded from helper-export and exporter-simplify prompts). This file is loaded by scripts/lib/test_utils.py.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Air Delivery.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Python closure bug in apworld causes OR rules to only check the last condition. APWorld bug, not exporter issue.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Ape Escape 3.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses Rulesets class with condense() method that returns closure (lambda state: self.check(state, player)). Exporter cannot trace through closure to extract actual rules stored in self.critical/self.rules lists. Rules export as unknown 'check' helper which defaults to True.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Astalon.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom RuleInstance pattern with caching that serializes incorrectly. Exporter captures caching logic instead of actual rules.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: ChecksMate.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom Material accumulator system. Items add numeric material values to state.prog_items[player]['Material'], and rules use meets_material_expectations() to check accumulated totals. Rule Builder cannot track computed properties.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Chrono Trigger Jets of Time.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Requires YAML generated from external web tool (multiworld.ctjot.com). World validates seed_share_link and raises InvalidYamlException for standard YAML configurations.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Corn Kidz 64.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom CK64Rule enum system with data-driven rule evaluation. Incompatible with rule exporter architecture.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Digimon World.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses iterative calculate_prosperity helper that accumulates prosperity by simulating digimon recruitment. Cannot export recursive state-tracking logic to Rule Builder format.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Frogmonster.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses functools.partial wrapping lambdas (unexportable) and has bug where 40 bug regions are not registered with multiworld.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom getModuleCounts() helper function with nested list counting logic. Exporter cannot translate this to Rule Builder - falls back to True_() making UT think all locations are accessible.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Monster Sanctuary.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom AccessCondition class with data-driven rule evaluation. Exporter sees lambda calling rules.has_access() but cannot introspect the AccessCondition tree structure.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Rabi-Ribi.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Helper complexity exceeds rule analyzer limits (30+ interdependent helpers). Analyzer hits 10000 call limit before full analysis.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Sly 2 Band of Thieves.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: APWorld bug: uses generation_is_fake to apply different rules during tracking vs generation. ThiefNet locations skip Episode requirements and Pickpocket locations get wrong region assignments during tracking.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Soul Blazer.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses closure-based data-driven rule pattern with RuleFlag enum dispatch. Cannot reconstruct rules without original closure context.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: The Legend of Zelda - Phantom Hourglass.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Entrance randomization fails frequently with complex option combinations. GER algorithm fails after 10 attempts with mixed pool settings.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: The Sims 4.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: APWorld bug: fill_slot_data() returns keys like 'goal' but generate_early() expects 'goal_value'. Key mismatch causes KeyError during worldgen regeneration.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: XCOM 2 War of the Chosen.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses custom RuleManager class with power-based access rules. Pattern incompatible with exporter/worldgen pipeline.

ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories.yaml
ut_fuzz_apworld_exclude_list.reason: Uses instance-level state (duelist_unlock_order, final_6_order) set randomly in generate_early() based on options. Access rules call is_card_location_accessible() which depends on this state and cannot be exported to static rules.
